name: Auto-9 Assistive Reticule
description: RoboCop-style targeting HUD. Auto-aims the reticule during the Skitarii Advanced Combat Doctrines ability, or on any class by tagging an enemy, with a scanner readout that names the subject.
author: Wobin

zh-cn.name: 机械战警目标扫描锁定框
zh-cn.description: 机械战警风格锁定HUD。护教军开启「高级作战教条」技能时自动生成目标锁定框；所有职业标记敌人后也可触发，附带扫描面板显示敌人名称。
